title: CRISPResso Analysis Protocol
author: Hanqin Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b4nxqvfn
materials: Use CRISPRessoBatch command if having many samples

steps.title: Run CRISPResso analysis
steps.instruction: In Linux, execute the following command: CRISPResso --fastq_r1 R1_reads.fastq.gz –fastq_r2 R2_reads.fastq.gz --amplicon_seq amplicon_seqeunce_here -g sgRNA_sequence_here
